caption: The drawing depicts a group of people in a dense composition dominated by brown, red, blue, and white tones. In the foreground, there is a large wooden cross, carried horizontally by two men who are bare-chested and wearing red and blue garments. One of the men is kneeling and appears to be struggling under the weight of the cross. Several soldiers, wearing helmets with blue and white or red and white decorations, surround them. These soldiers hold long spears upright in the background. On the right side, a horse with a brown coat, outlined with black hooves and a red saddle, is partly visible, with a rider dressed in a red and white outfit sitting astride it. The background consists of brown and stone-like structures with an arch visible on the far right. The scene is densely packed with figures and weapons, and the colors are muted and earthy overall, with details in the costumes and armor of the figures.
title: Station of The Cross No. 3: "Jesus Falls the First Time"
